tags.name: Vanilla
tags.desc: Ordinary sudoku. No other rules apply

tags.name: Black Kropki
tags.desc: Digits seperated by a black kropki dot must differ in a 1:2 ratio
tags.neg: All black kropki dots are given

tags.name: White Kropki
tags.desc: Digits seperated by a white kropki dot must differ by 1
tags.neg: All white kropki dots are given

tags.name: Killer Cage
tags.desc: Digits inside a cage can't repeat and must sum to the value written on the cage

tags.name: Little Killer
tags.desc: Arrowed numbers outside the grid denote the sum of all cells along their pointed lines

tags.name: V and X Sums
tags.desc: Digits seperated by a V or X must sum to 5 or 10, respectively
tags.neg: All V's and X's are given

tags.name: Arrow
tags.desc: The digits on an arrow sum to the value in the attached circle

tags.name: Anti-Knight
tags.desc: A digit can't be within a chess knight's move of itself

tags.name: Anti-King
tags.desc: A digit can't be within a chess king's move of itself

tags.name: Renban
tags.desc: Digits on a pink renban line can't repeat and must form a continuous, consecutive set

tags.name: German Whisper
tags.desc: Adjacent digits on a green whisper line must differ by 5 or more

tags.name: Whisper
tags.desc: Adjacent digits on a whisper line must differ by a given amount

tags.name: Region Sum
tags.desc: Region borders divide a region sum line into segments. Each segment's digits must sum to the same value

tags.name: Parity Line
tags.desc: Adjacent digits on a parity line must be odd and even

tags.name: Entropy Line
tags.desc: Any set of 3 adjacent cells on an entropy line must contain a low (1-3), medium (4-6), and high (7-9) digit

tags.name: Modular Line
tags.desc: Any set of 3 adjacent cells on a modular line must have a unique remainder when divided by 3

tags.name: Palindrome Line
tags.desc: The digits in each cell along a palindrome line must read the same forwards and backwards

tags.name: Irregular
tags.desc: Regions boundaries are irregularly shaped

tags.name: Chaos Construction
tags.desc: Region boundaries are irregularly shaped and must be deduced by the solver

tags.name: Thermometer
tags.desc: Digits on a thermometer must strictly increase from bulb to tip

tags.name: Slow Thermometer
tags.desc: Digits on a thermometer must not decrease from bulb to tip

tags.name: Skyscraper
tags.desc: Numbers outside the grid indicate how many digits are visible when looking into the grid. Digits block visibility of lower digits behind them

tags.name: Modifier Cells
tags.desc: Some cells have a different value than the digit they contain

tags.name: Pathing
tags.desc: The solver must draw a path or loop based on some criteria

tags.name: Shading
tags.desc: The solver must color cells based on some criteria

tags.name: Position Clue
tags.desc: There's a unique clue that can determine cell values based on their position

tags.name: Math Clue
tags.desc: There's a unique clue that can determine cell values based on math

tags.name: Math Clue
tags.desc: There's a unique clue that can determine cell values based on a pattern

tags.name: Unique
tags.desc: The main component of this puzzle can't be explained with existing tags
